title: Intrinsic Barriers and Practical Pathways for Human-AI Alignment: An Agreement-Based Complexity Analysis
reasoning: The paper provides a formal complexity-theoretic analysis of the value alignment problem, specifically addressing the challenges of reaching consensus among agents on human values such as helpfulness, harmlessness, and honesty. It establishes a 'No-Free-Lunch' principle for encoding human values, which is a foundational ethical and meta-ethical concern in AI alignment research.
